items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: And he'd get us out on the street playing an appetite and get us on the corner.

ctx.x: What was that show? Mm-hmm. That came out after. Mm-hmm. And Jack caught up from a, buying a record, you know, he caught up in there. And he used to play, when he first come out, wouldn't want nobody to play with him. And he'd get us out on the street playing an appetite and get us on the corner. He'd play nothing to Tiger Rag.
